mapper.select: SELECT 'READY' AS status,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(created_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT created_at FROM tc_job_lease FORCE INDEX(ix_job_publication_age) WHERE job_type='OUTBOX_PUBLISH' AND status='READY' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_ready UNION ALL SELECT 'RUNNING' AS status,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(created_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT created_at FROM tc_job_lease FORCE INDEX(ix_job_publication_age) WHERE job_type='OUTBOX_PUBLISH' AND status='RUNNING' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_running UNION ALL SELECT 'REVIEW' AS status,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(created_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT created_at FROM tc_job_lease FORCE INDEX(ix_job_publication_age) WHERE job_type='OUTBOX_PUBLISH' AND status='REVIEW' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_review
